formal_role: Defines each variable in the input space
review_warning: A multivariable function should not be interpreted without clear input definitions

formal_role: Defines input combinations where the function is defined
systems_modeling_role: Separates computable inputs from meaningful scenarios
review_warning: Outputs outside the modeling domain may be invalid even when the formula computes

formal_role: Records constraints on allowable input combinations
systems_modeling_role: Prevents impossible scenarios from being treated as valid outputs
review_warning: Inputs may be mathematically valid but physically or ethically infeasible

systems_modeling_role: Clarifies whether variables act independently or jointly
review_warning: Omitted interactions may distort system interpretation

formal_role: Identifies input combinations that produce equal output
systems_modeling_role: Supports tradeoff threshold and contour reasoning
review_warning: Contours require domain and feasibility interpretation

formal_role: Defines where the relationship is intended to hold
systems_modeling_role: Prevents local response surfaces from becoming global truth
review_warning: A function calibrated in one region may not be valid under extrapolation
